description_en: A mounting plate with elongated slots
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 120     # 板宽 (mm)
height = 60     # 板高 (mm)
thickness = 5   # 板厚 (mm)
slot_length = 20  # 槽长 (mm)
slot_width = 6    # 槽宽 (mm)
slot_spacing = 40 # 槽间距 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, height, thickness)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .rarray(slot_spacing, 1, 3, 1)
    .slot2D(slot_length, slot_width)
    .cutThruAll()
)

show_object(result)
